correctness.rationale: The exact density is obtained by integrating the valid positive bivariate FGM exponential joint density. Its logarithmic curvature reduces to F(t,θ)=-1+L(t)θ+Q(t)θ². For θ≤0, a positive mixture decomposition yields strict negative curvature; for θ≥0,t≤1 concavity follows from A′>0,A″≤0. For t>1, the proof establishes Q<0 and L<2, making F/θ² strictly increasing on 0<θ≤1; thus a global variational minimum gives the sharp threshold and an attained transition. An exact rational lower bound on log4 proves F(log4,1)>0. Endpoints, positivity, and rate rescaling have been independently reconstructed. The packaged standard-library verifier tests exact polynomial identities and separate integral computations; finite tests are not the universal proof.

originality.rationale: Material full text of Navarro and Pellerey, DOI 10.1002/asmb.2657, Example 2, derives the same FGM exponential-sum law and establishes IFR, but contains only a graphical ILR remark and no sharp parameter classification. The new analytic curvature identity and exact positive-curvature counterexample at θ=1 show that its unrestricted graphical ILR interpretation does not hold. Navarro–Pellerey–Mulero DOI 10.1007/s11749-022-00805-2 treats TTE rather than FGM dependence. Indexed mathematics searches under equivalent shape terminology and FGM copulas found no covering result; the nearest FGM record concerns block substitution, not the sum density. Navarro–Sarabia DOI 10.1017/S0269964820000649 is an incompletely accessible related work and remains a substantive priority risk; searches alone do not prove uniqueness.

value.rationale: The exact ILR/log-concavity boundary gives a complete natural two-variable dependent-exponential classification and identifies a genuine separation from the IFR aging class. It also corrects the source paper’s unsupported graphical ILR claim at legal parameter θ=1. This is motivated by survival reliability and dependable use of stronger aging assumptions, not by an arbitrary isolated numeric threshold. It neither overstates wider copula results nor claims parameter-minimizer uniqueness.
